g.text: Yellow: layer 1, entities (src/domain/engine/). The engine imports no variant and no framework.
Dashed box at the top right of a class: its type parameters (UML template).
«Strategy», «Command» and so on: the role of the class in a GoF pattern.
«port»: an interface that an outer layer implements (see layers.md).
Every class is planned. src/domain/engine/ holds only a README today.
stars for Fit, plain levels for Sort
generic gives the engine the board and the score.
this port. Presenters, the score display and
the audio facade subscribe to the bus.
